Example Product multi-user edition

Share your Example Product setup with your whole team and work together on your management and information system, from incoming calls in the CRM to the yearly balance sheet in accounting.

The networked offer is counted in users who connect and work at the same time.

The product is not licensed per computer, nor per named user, but per simultaneous access to the application. These are called tokens or concurrent sessions.

Network edition from 30 EUR per month and per concurrent user

This offer is based on the most complete pack, including every option: general, analytical and budget accounting, sales and purchasing, suppliers and stock, CRM and payroll, all utilities, up to 25 separate companies, all updates and technical support.

If you already have a single-computer subscription, it will be cancelled at no cost when you subscribe to the multi-user edition, without affecting your data or settings.
